item.title: EplayerX 1.2.34
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 支持在统一搜索中查找已扫描的网盘和网络共享媒体库，按影片与剧集浏览结果。 - 改善媒体详情手动刷新，让资源、季和剧集信息及时更新。 - 修复跨设备同步后本地专属媒体源顺序变化的问题。 - 更新 Pro 会员页面，优化方案切换、功能介绍和购买状态展示。 - 改善字幕翻译服务的网络错误处理与重试体验。 - 改善弱网环境下已缓存视频的跳转响应。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Search scanned cloud-drive and network-share libraries alongside your other media sources, with movie and TV results. - Improved manual refresh on media details so sources, seasons, and episodes update promptly. - Fixed local-only media sources changing position after cross-device sync. - Refreshed the Pro membership page with clearer plan switching, feature descriptions, and purchase status. - Improved network error handling and retries for subtitle translation services. - Improved seeking responsiveness for cached video on slow or stalled connections.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
